case_1_transactional_confirmation.name: Case 1: Transactional Email Confirmation & Momentum Builder
case_1_transactional_confirmation.trigger: Triggered immediately when a user creates an account

received_email.subject: Confirm your email address now!
received_email.preheader: Please verify your email address to continue
received_email.body_summary: Hello friend, We're delighted that you'd like to become part of our community. Before you can register, we would like to ask you to confirm your email address by using the following link: [ Confirm email address ]. Thanks and best regards, Your Team
received_email.strengths: Clean layout, zero spam triggers, clear single call to action, fast deliverability.
received_email.optimization_opportunity: Transactional emails have a 65%+ open rate. Treating this email solely as a transactional barrier wastes the highest-intent moment when the user is eager to start.

variant_b_hypothesis.subject: Confirm your email & unlock your trading workspace 🚀
variant_b_hypothesis.preheader: Top traded assets today & automated Sparplan preview inside
variant_b_hypothesis.hypothesis: Adding a post-confirmation teaser (Top 3 Market Movers + 1-Click Sparplan Preview) below the primary CTA turns passive confirmation into active momentum without adding friction.
key_changes: High-contrast primary confirmation button preserved at the top.
Visual 'What's waiting in your app' preview box below the CTA.
Clear expectation setting: 3-minute Video-Ident & 0€ deposit fee.

case_2_welcome_verification.name: Case 2: Onboarding & Video-Ident Friction Breaker
case_2_welcome_verification.trigger: Triggered upon email confirmation (or 24h unverified reminder)

received_email.subject: Welcome to the Trading App 👋
received_email.preheader: When it comes to trading, our exchange is a partner you can rely on
received_email.body_summary: Hi, You've just become part of our community and are now able to use the best crypto app in Germany! When it comes to trading, our exchange-backed platform is a partner you can rely on. Our goal is to make trading as simple as possible for you. There's no need for a wallet, securities account, or even paperwork. [ Verify now ]. Are you familiar with the app and ready to start trading? Just take a few minutes to verify your identity through a simple video identification process. [ Verify now ]
received_email.strengths: Strong trust anchor (exchange backing), friendly tone, reiterates 'no wallet complexity' value proposition.
received_email.optimization_opportunity: Long text paragraphs create cognitive hesitation. Users fear the Video-Ident call will be long or require physical paper documents.

metrics.dropoff_stage: 42% drop off before connecting to Video-Ident agent

variant_b_hypothesis.subject: Your account is 1 step away: 3-min ID checklist 🛡️
variant_b_hypothesis.preheader: Instant verification • No paperwork • Regulated European custody
variant_b_hypothesis.hypothesis: Replacing generic paragraphs with an interactive 3-step time-stamped visual checklist + direct mobile app deep link reduces perceived friction and boosts Video-Ident initiation.
key_changes: 3-Step Checklist: Step 1: ID Ready (1 min) → Step 2: 2-min Video Call → Step 3: Trade Instantly.
Mobile App Deep-Link (app://verify/video-ident) launching verification directly in-app.
Reassurance Badges: BaFin/EU Regulated, Insured Custody, 0€ Setup Fee.

case_3_editorial_faizex_market_digest.name: Case 3: Monthly Market Newsletter & Dynamic Lifecycle CTAs
case_3_editorial_faizex_market_digest.email_name: Hi, here's your Faizex Market Digest for August 📰 / 🙌
case_3_editorial_faizex_market_digest.trigger: Monthly broadcast sent to all registered platform users

received_email.subject: Hi, here's your Faizex Market Digest for August 📰
received_email.preheader: Bitcoin has woken up and pulled the market out of hibernation

sections.title: Header & Intro
sections.content: Bitcoin has woken up—and pulled the entire crypto market out of hibernation. The wake-up call came from Washington, where the US debt pile is spiraling out of control.

sections.title: Market News Breakdown
sections.content: Nvidia quarterly earnings surprise, US $35 trillion debt burden and interest rate pressures, Bitcoin & Gold rally amidst macro expansion.

sections.title: Coin of the Month
sections.content: Solana ETF inflows & institutional altcoin traction.

received_email.strengths: Outstanding editorial quality, approachable tone, attractive 3D graphics, demystifies macro events for retail investors.
received_email.optimization_opportunity: A single static 'Trade Bitcoin' CTA ignores where the user is in their customer lifecycle. Beginners feel unready to trade spot Bitcoin, while active holders want portfolio insights.

variant_b_hypothesis.subject: Market Digest: Institutional flows & Volatility shift [Your Portfolio Impact] 📈
variant_b_hypothesis.preheader: Bitcoin macro breakdown + personalized accumulation roadmap
variant_b_hypothesis.hypothesis: Maintaining the excellent editorial market report while dynamically swapping the Call-to-Action module based on user lifecycle stage increases conversion without harming the editorial experience.
